screenshots.title: Passage of the Buck
screenshots.caption: A dollar carries a story from person to person, four words at a time. The hosted prototype uses PayPal sandbox test money.

screenshots.title: Meet Wendell the Damp
screenshots.caption: Every bill gets a name, a voice and a journey. Wendell is a labeled demo bill with simulated early history.

screenshots.title: The Story and The Passage
screenshots.caption: Read the story beside its city-by-city route, then inspect a hop and its masked PayPal receipt.
screenshots.notes: FWP-0002 has labeled demo history; its latest displayed receipt is a PayPal sandbox payout.

screenshots.title: Four words that count
screenshots.caption: The live word counter counts “lights” and “dimmed”; connecting words ride free.

screenshots.title: The Diary and The Passport
screenshots.caption: The bill narrates its travels in an AI-written diary and collects illustrated city stamps.
screenshots.notes: Wendell is a demo bill. The newest stamp is visibly still inking; completed historical stamps are shown as rendered.

screenshots.title: Join from the wild
screenshots.caption: A bill released to the wild waits for a stranger to claim it and add the next four words.
screenshots.notes: Only the public list is opened; no bill is claimed.

screenshots.title: Sandbox checkout
screenshots.caption: Starting a story costs $2 in PayPal sandbox test money. The page provides a published test card and PayPal’s checkout button.
screenshots.notes: Unsubmitted form with example.com sample values. No order was created, no payment was submitted and no email was sent.

screenshots.title: Open Books
screenshots.caption: A public ledger shows the observed PayPal sandbox totals and payments over time. Demo payments are excluded.
screenshots.notes: At capture: $0 paid in, $3 paid out, 3 sandbox payouts. These are current test counts, not adoption or real-money metrics.

screenshots.title: The PayPal ledger
screenshots.caption: The ledger exposes PayPal status, masked references, landing times and webhook confirmation without publishing email addresses.
screenshots.notes: Gallery card with an unaltered screenshot of the live ledger and a caption outside it. The date and empty hop columns were hidden with AG Grid’s normal drag-out interaction to show payment verification. Three observed sandbox payouts.

screenshots.title: A bill’s own eulogy
screenshots.caption: A bill that has stopped traveling writes a eulogy in its own voice. Valentine’s journey is labeled demo history.

screenshots.title: Fork the story
screenshots.caption: Start a new branch from a chosen hop and carry the story in another direction.
screenshots.notes: Fork dialog only. No checkout, branch, payout or email is created.
